static_traits.name: Lin Hao
static_traits.social_status: Impaired self-esteem导致社交意愿下降，避免与朋友外出就餐；与室友可谈日常但not愿分享自卑感
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；此前without类似心理问题史；not yet接受过心理咨询或治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能描述情绪与行为；思维偏负性、自我贬低，倾向negate积极反馈；对改变持怀疑但愿意尝试，配合度尚可，语气整体消极

basic_info.main_problem: 因自己喜欢吃通心粉奶酪而感到“without聊、not趣和很差劲”，影响自我认知与自尊，进而Avoids socializing与尝试新活动。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I noticed this inferiority limits my social interactions and overall enjoyment of life.
growth_experiences: 约一年前在社交媒体与社会舆论的持续影响下，逐渐内化“独特、敢于尝试才算有趣/酷”的价值标准；在吃通心粉奶酪或看到他人尝试多样食物时感到自卑与羞耻，随后减少与朋友外出就餐、尝试过新食物和新活动但仍negate积极反馈，问题逐步加重并影响日常生活与社交。

core_beliefs: 我是without聊、幼稚、have not吸引力的人
My value depends on others' evaluations以及我是否足够“与众not同/勇于尝试”

special_situations.event: 独自或与他人用餐时选择通心粉奶酪
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的饮食喜好not够多样或not够“冒险”，就说明我是without聊且not值得被认可的人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 自我批评、强迫自己尝试新食物以证明自己“not是without聊的人”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我这么吃太幼稚、太not趣了

special_situations.event: Sees others trying diverse foods or social media praise for 'adventurous eating'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人更“多样/独特”，他们就比我更优秀、更值得被关注
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Compares and demeans himself on social media, reduces eating out with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: do not人都比我有趣，生活也比我好

special_situations.event: Others' positive feedback on one's trying new foods or efforts
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 若表扬很小或来自熟人，就not算数、not可信
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate积极反馈，认为对方只是出于礼貌
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是客气，not是真的这么想

special_situations.event: Plans to dine out with friends or thinks about possibly being seen by others making my dietary choices
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我按自己的口味点餐，就会被他人看not起、嘲笑
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与朋友外出就餐，Reduced socializing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我很幼稚、很without聊

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被接纳、被视为有价值并且“有趣”，能按自己的喜好生活而not被羞辱
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被嘲笑、被贬低与被贴上“幼稚/without聊”的标签，从而Being rejected或排斥
defense_goal: 通过Avoids socializing减少被评判的机会
通过negate他人的积极反馈来避免希望与失望的波动
Preemptive self-deprecation to reduce the impact when humiliated

object_relations.object_representation: Harsh, comparison-loving judges or superior peers / the public

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor gives affirmation or emphasizes one's positive efforts (such as being willing to try self-compassion)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为他人的肯定“not是真诚的，只是礼貌”，难以接纳正向反馈
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 淡化或拆解称赞，用“这not算什么/只是客气”回应，语气保留、避免情感投入。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing how others may view their eating preferences or performance in social settings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将内在的自我批评体验Projection为“do not人会看not起我/觉得我幼稚”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用确定语气陈述“他们会嘲笑我”，not主动求证证据，伴随紧张与回避。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor encourages trying new cognitive or self-compassion practices
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 以“这很假/对我not用”为由拒绝尝试，从而维持既有认知
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gives reasons in a calm but skeptical tone (such as 'it feels fake') to politely decline the exercise, reducing emotional involvement.

manifestations: Personal preferences swayed by social media and social standards
为迎合“有趣/酷”的外在标准而Repression真实偏好
outcomes: 自我异化与羞耻感增强

manifestations: not愿向室友谈及自卑与not足感
outcomes: 社会联结减少、可用支持受限

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Takes the social standard that 'daring to try novel foods counts as interesting/cool' as the sole basis for self-evaluation
use“应该/必须更会尝试”的内在语言苛责自己

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Presuming others will ridicule one's dietary preferences ('they will think I am childish')
将自我批评体验Projection为外界的负面评价

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 高度自我苛责、反复比较并negate自己
对他人称赞保持怀疑并迅速negate其有效性

positive_force: 工作表现稳定，具备基本生活规律
能自我觉察到问题并主动寻求帮助
Shows a certain willingness to try in counseling (despite having doubts)
具备日常支持性关系基础（Lives with roommates）
negative_force: Excessively concerned about outside evaluations and internalizes social media standards
Avoids socializing与外出就餐，Reinforcement负性信念
negate积极反馈，难以整合正向经验

antecedent: 想到自己会点通心粉奶酪
看到他人尝试多样食物
刷到社交媒体对“冒险饮食”的赞美
target_behavior.core_reason: 内化“多样/冒险才有价值”的标准，担心被评判为幼稚和without聊，引发羞耻与Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Escaping being evaluated and shame, gaining a short-term sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced socializing、Loneliness感上升，Decreased enjoyment of life并维持负性自我认知

target_behavior.behavior: negate他人的积极反馈（“他们只是礼貌”）
antecedent: Others' praise/approval of one's trying new foods or efforts
咨询师的正向反映与鼓励
target_behavior.core_reason: 维持既有“我很without聊/not够好”的图式以避免期望落空的痛苦
target_behavior.function: 维持认知一致性、降低情感脆弱感
target_behavior.consequence: 难以整合正向经验，自尊without法提升，消极情绪持续

target_behavior.behavior: Self-deprecating negative self-talk (such as 'I am childish/terrible')
antecedent: 看到他人多样化饮食或社交媒体内容
想到要与他人同吃一餐
target_behavior.core_reason: 将个体偏好与整体人价值进行全或without的等同，过度概括自身缺陷
target_behavior.function: Through preemptive self-criticism, tries to control the emotional impact when humiliated by others
target_behavior.consequence: 加重羞耻与Anxiety，进一步Avoids socializing并降低生活满足感
